def nrow():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            if c0<13: return r0  # the well N token (col 8-10)
    return None
print("start N well row:", nrow())
for i in range(8):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':12}])
    r=nrow()
    flags={k:res.get(k) for k in ['gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward']}
    print(i+1,"N well row:",r,flags)
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('no_impact'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def nrow():
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
            if c0<13: return r0  # the well N token (col 8-10)
    return None
print("start N well row:", nrow())
for i in range(8):
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':56,'col':12}])
    r=nrow()
    flags={k:res.get(k) for k in ['gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done','reward']}
    print(i+1,"N well row:",r,flags)
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done') or res.get('no_impact'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
